description: This file is a pytest configuration script (`conftest.py`) for setting up testing fixtures and test collection modifications in a Python project. It defines fixtures for event loop management and setup/teardown routines for tests involving the `litellm` module, as well as custom test sorting logic.

methods.name: event_loop()
methods.description: Fixture that provides an asyncio event loop for testing, creating a new one if none is running.

methods.name: setup_and_teardown()
methods.description: Fixture that reloads the 'litellm' module and sets up an asyncio event loop before each test function, ensuring a clean environment for each test run.

methods.name: pytest_collection_modifyitems(config, items)
methods.description: Function to reorder test collection items, segregating and sorting tests based on their parent names to prioritize specialized tests.
